_comment: NSW planning zone taxonomy — legacy (pre-26 April 2023) to current zone code alias map. Source of truth for DQ-30 (see .claude/DATA_QUALITY_TRACKER.md). Generated/verified by scripts/generate_zone_taxonomy.py — regenerate via that script rather than hand-editing. Reflects the NSW DPE Employment Zones Reform, effective 26 April 2023, which replaced Business (B1-B8) and Industrial (IN1-IN4) zones with Employment (E1-E5) and Mixed Use (MU1) zones. Consumed by frontend-nextjs/lib/zone-translation.ts (TypeScript) and enrichment/config/zone_taxonomy.py (Python) — do not maintain a separate copy in either language.
